Rooms.Name: On the High Seas
Rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. A gusty wind blows from the west.
Far to the south you see a coastline, even darker than the water below
you.

Exits.Description: The Ocean stretches out endlessly to the north.
You see cliffs to the south.

Rooms.Name: By the cliffs
Rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. To the south you see cliffs with
lethal reefs just before them. You also see some wreckage there, probably
from ships that have been crushed.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian stretches out endlessly to north.

Rooms.Name: By the cliffs
Rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. To the south you see the outflow from
the Black Lagoon. Here the ocean water is mixed with the almost black
water from the Black River.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian stretches out endlessly to north.
You see the outflow from the Black Lagoon to the south.

Rooms.Name: In the outflow of the Black Lagoon
Rooms.Description:
You are in the outflow of the Black Lagoon. To the north lies
the Great Mindorian Ocean, and to the south lies the mysterious Black
Lagoon. To the west you can see deadly, dark cliffs.

Exits.Description: To the north lies the Mindorian Ocean.
To the south lies the Black Lagoon.

Rooms.Name: In the outflow of the Black Lagoon
Rooms.Description:
You are in the outflow of the Black Lagoon. To the north lies
the Great Mindorian Ocean, and to the south lies the mysterious Black
Lagoon. To the east you can see deadly, dark cliffs.

Exits.Description: To the north lies the Mindorian Ocean.
To the south lies the Black Lagoon.

Rooms.Name: On the deeper Water
Rooms.Description:
You are on the dark water of the Black Lagoon. To the north you see
high impassable cliffs and far to the south you see the shore. Although
the water is not transparent anywhere you have a feeling that it isn't shallow
here.

Exits.Description: You see the shore far to the south.

Exits.Description: The outflow of the Black Lagoon lies to the north.

Rooms.Name: On the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shallow water of the Black Lagoon. The water here is so dark
that you can't see the ground here. To the south lies the shore and far to the
north you see high, dark cliffs.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shallow water of the Black Lagoon. The water here is so dark
that you can't see the ground here. To the south you see the outflow of the
Black River and far to the north you see high, dark cliffs.

Exits.Description: You see the outflow from the Black River to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shallow water of the Black Lagoon. The water here is so dark
that you can't see the ground here. To the south lies the shore and far to the
north you see high, dark cliffs.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shallow water of the Black Lagoon. The water here is so dark
that you can't see the ground here. To the south lies the shore and you see
the outflow of the Black Lagoon to the north.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shallow water of the Black Lagoon. The water here is so dark
that you can't see the ground here. To the south lies the shore and a cottage
and you see the outflow of the Black Lagoon to the north.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shallow water of the Black Lagoon. To the south you see the
shore and to the north you see high cliffs that encase this Lagoon. The water
is very not transparent at all, because it comes from the Black River.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shallow water of the Black Lagoon. To the south you see the
shore and to the north you see high cliffs that encase this Lagoon. The water
is very not transparent at all, because it comes from the Black River.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shallow water of the Black Lagoon. To the south you see the
shore and to the north you see high cliffs that encase this Lagoon. The water
is very not transparent at all, because it comes from the Black River.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shore of the Black Lagoon. To the south you see some rocks and
to the east is the outflow of the Black River. The ground here is filled with
wreckage from ancient seafaring vessels.

Exits.Description: You see the outflow of the Black River there.

Rooms.Name: On the outflow of the river
Rooms.Description:
You are on the outflow of the Black River. Hundreds of cubic-meters of black
dirty water flows out in the lagoon each second. The river continues to the
south and to the north you see the Black Lagoon.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shore of the Black Lagoon. To the south you see the deserted
beach and to the west you see the outflow of the Black River. The sand here has
a smell of rotten corpses and burned wood. Hmmmmm...

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are on the shore of the Black Lagoon. To the south you see the beach and
to the east you see a small cottage. Wreckage lies here on the ground, and some
green slime too.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The slime is fresh, green and smelly.
The wreckage must be from a ship of some kind.

Rooms.Name: Captain Silver's Beach Shop
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in Captain Silver's dirty shop. Loads of broken items litter
the floor here, along with more or less functional boats. As you look around
you notice that the spider-webs on the ceiling must be some 10 years old.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The webs are filled with fat, happy spiders that are constantly feed by the
old captain.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the Black Lagoon. You see strange footprints
in the grey sand here, covered with grayish green slime. To the south you see
the beach and to the west you see a cottage.

Exits.Description: You see the beach to the south.
Captain Silver's shop lies to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The footprints are made by a some kind of amphibian creature.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the Black Lagoon. The grey sand and the 
black water of the lagoon mixes into a sickly grayish mix. To the south you 
see the beach and even further that way you see the jungle.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the Black Lagoon. A statue made of wood 
stands here, firmly attached to the ground. It looks several hundreds years 
old. To the south you see the beach.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The statue resembles a demon with a huge sword in the left hand and a staff in
the other. The eyes on the statue seems to watch you with suspicion.

Rooms.Name: On the rocks
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on some slippery rocks by the Black River. To the north
you see the Black Lagoon, to the east the Black River and to the south you see
the jungle.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
You are on the Black River. To river comes out from the jungle to the south
and enters the Black Lagoon to the north of here. You see some rocks to the 
west and a deserted beach to the east.

Exits.Description: You see the Black Lagoon to the north.
The grayish beach lies to the east.
The river comes out from the jungle there.

Rooms.Name: On the beach
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the beach of the Black Lagoon. The grey sand here is a 
great contrast to the bluish green jungle that lies to the south of here.To
the west you see the Black River and you notice a well used path leading into
the jungle to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the north.
The beach continues to the east of here.
The path leads into the jungle.
You see the dark water of the Black River there.

Rooms.Name: On the beach
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the beach of the Black Lagoon. The beach is totally
deserted and it somehow make your feel uncomfortable. You hear the faint sound
of parrots from the jungle to the south of here.

Rooms.Name: On the beach
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the beach of the Black Lagoon. To the north you see a 
cottage. You hear the faint sound of parrots from the jungle to the south of 
here.

Exits.Description: Captain Silver's shop lies to the north.

Rooms.Name: On the beach
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the beach of the Black Lagoon. You see a strange symbol
written in the grey sand here. As you try to erase it the sand reforms and
the symbol appears again. To the south you see a small path that leads into
the jungle.

Exits.Description: The path is not very well used it seems.

Rooms.Name: On the beach
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the beach of the Black Lagoon. The beach looks quite 
deserted and it makes you squirm. Suddenly you notice something splashing in
the water. But it wasn't a fish, it was something scaly, ugly, green and slimy.
You see the jungle to the south of here.

Rooms.Name: On the beach
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the beach of the Black Lagoon. To the north you see a
statue standing on the shore and to the south you see the jungle.

Rooms.Name: On the Black River
Rooms.Description:
You are on the Black River. On both sides of you strange tropical trees loom
above you. To the north the jungle opens up to the Black Lagoon and to the 
south and up stream is the jungle getting darker. All around you hear sounds
of animals and creatures that lives in the trees here. To the east you see
a trail along the river.

Exits.Description: You see the Lagoon to the north.
You spot an old wooden bridge to the south.

Rooms.Name: Under the Bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are under a bridge on the Black River. In the darkness here u barely spot
a ladder that can take you up to the bridge. The river flows north to the
Mindorian Ocean from here.

Exits.Description: The river flows to the north of here.
The river flows in from the south of here.
A ladder can take you up from here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ladder looks quite old but you think it can hold your weight anyway.

Rooms.Name: On the Black River
Rooms.Description:
You are on the Black River. The fantastic vegetation of the jungle almost 
overwhelms you as you look on each shore of the river. On the east side 
you spot a trail along the river, though it's impossible to go up there
from this side. To the south you see that the river is bending of to the 
east and to the north you see a bridge.

Exits.Description: You see a bridge to the north.

Rooms.Name: On a trail in the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a trail leading deeper into the jungle to the
south. The bushes on the east side of the trail rustles of creatures
sneaking around in there. To the west you see the Black River and to
the north you see the Lagoon.

Exits.Description: You see the beach of the Black Lagoon to the north.
The trail leads deeper into the jungle.

Rooms.Name: By the bridge in the jungle
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a trail in the jungle. The sounds of exotic birds
and beasts fill the air, which is being cool and moist. To the west you
see an old bridge made of wood that spans over the Black River. The trail
leads in a north south direction.

Exits.Description: The trail goes along the river.
The trail goes along the river.
The bridge lies to the west of here.

Rooms.Name: On the old bridge in the jungle
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on an old bridge. It looks very fragile and simple, but
never the less it span over the river which is more than 150 feet across. You
see a small ladder that can take you down to the black water.

Exits.Description: You see a trail in the north south direction to the east.
The trail continues to the west.
You can climb down to the water from here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ladder leads down to the water level.

Rooms.Name: On a trail in the jungle
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a trail in the jungle. On both sides of the trail
strange trees and vegetation loom. The sounds of the jungle is somewhat
louder here. You notice some beautiful flowers high up in the canopy. To
the east you see a bridge.

Rooms.Name: On the Black River
Rooms.Description:
The river makes a sharp turn here, flowing in from the east and towards
the bridge you barely notice to the north. The black water is filled with
strange looking fishes and insects that is searching for food. To the west
, east and above you the jungle is very dense and the air is filled with
moist.

Rooms.Name: On the Black River
Rooms.Description:
You are on the dark, dirty water of the Black River. The water flows slowly
from the east to the west. As you look to the north you see a bridge spanning
over the river and to the west you see that the river bends to the north.

Rooms.Name: On a trail in the jungle
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a well used trail in the jungle. On both sides of you
huge trees loom above you, so close together that it is impossible to move
between them. The air is filled with sounds of birds singing and you almost
*hear* the vegetation growing around you. To the south you the trail leading
out of the forest to the Black Lagoon.

Exits.Description: You see the Lagoon to the north.

Rooms.Name: The jungle clearing
Rooms.Description:
You are in a clearing in the jungle. Small birds darts in and out of the
trees, diving for the insects that swarms around you. The trail continues to
the north and east, and to the west you notice a small path leading deeper
into the jungle.

Exits.Description: You see the trail to the north.
You see the trail to the east.
A small path leads deeper into the jungle to the west.

Rooms.Name: On a small path in the jungle
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a small path. It is getting darker here as the canopy 
above you becomes more dense. To the east you see a clearing in the jungle
and the path is winding of to the south.

Exits.Description: You see a clearing to the east.

Rooms.Name: On a small path in the jungle
Rooms.Description:
The dense growth of the jungle floor makes it difficult to move quickly.To 
the north you see the path winding deeper into the jungle.

Rooms.Name: On a trail in the jungle
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a trail in the vast jungle. The light filter down
through the canopy yet it hardly reaches the jungle floor. To the west you see
a clearing, and the trail winds of to the east, although it seems impossible
to go there.

Exits.Description: You see a clearing in the jungle.

Rooms.Name: On the trail along the river
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a trail along the Black River. The air is so damp that 
your clothes cling to your body. To the west and south you see the river 
flowing slowly to the Mindorian Ocean far to the north. The trail is winding
north and east through the jungle.

Rooms.Name: By a bridge in the jungle
Rooms.Description:
You are standing by a bridge in the vast jungle. a swarm of small red insects
is starting to like you as they fly around and lands on every itchy spot. The
bridge can take you to south and to the trail is winding to the west.

Exits.Description: You see a bridge there.

Rooms.Name: On a bridge in the jungle
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a bridge in the jungle. Below you the Black River flows
silently in a east west direction. You notice that it's quite easy to climb
down to the river from here. The trail continues to the north and to the south.

Rooms.Name: Under the bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are under a bridge on the Black River. This place is filled with spider-
webs and other sticky slime things. The river flows from the east to the west
and you can climb up to the bridge.

Rooms.Name: On a trail in the jungle
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a trail in the jungle. Around you a myriad of flowers
and bushes grows at a exceptional speed. To the north you see a bridge that
spans over the Black River.

Mobs.Name: deep one creature
Mobs.LongDescription: The evil Deep One chants in a very odd, very wicked language.
Mobs.Description:
The Deep One has found the fabled sunken continent of R'liagh, and joined
with its fellow deep ones in continual prayers to invoke the most 
evil of evil.  Resembling a human covered with fish scales and enhanced
with gills, the sheer evil presence of this monster is enough to knock
down your armor class by several points.

Mobs.Name: deep one creature
Mobs.LongDescription: The evil Deep One swims in an endless search for the sunken island R'liagh.
Mobs.Description:
Fish scales cover the once-human body of the evil Deep One, faithful 
subject of the evil god Cthulu.  Once this poor soul wandered solid
ground. Increasingly evil, increasingly drawn to water, one day he murdered
an entire town, then walked into the sea.

Mobs.Name: Thraxx
Mobs.LongDescription: A Thraxx is trying to drag you down into the water with its four arms!
Mobs.Description:
This thing is an amphibious creature with six eyes on its salamander-like head.
It raises its four muscular arms and and claws you with suprising ferocity.

Mobs.Name: piranha pirana
Mobs.LongDescription: Some Piranhas are searching for blood.
Mobs.Description:
This fish has red scales with a dark pattern. Although the fish is 
quite small the mouth is huge and has thousands of small teeth.
Piranhas go through toothbrushes rather quickly.

Mobs.Name: Argundian Tiger
Mobs.LongDescription: A big bad tiger is devouring you with his hungry eyes.

Mobs.Name: parrot ara
Mobs.LongDescription: A parrot is sitting on the lower branches of a tree.
Mobs.Description:
The parrot is talking constantly meaningless words that it has picked up from
people travelling on the trail.

Mobs.Name: cannibal native
Mobs.LongDescription: A Cannibal rushes out from the bushes and attacks you!
Mobs.Description:
The Cannibal stares back at you with crazed eyes. He is wearing only a
loincloth of deerskin and has a feather from a horn-bird behind his left
ear.

Mobs.Name: captain silver
Mobs.LongDescription: Captain Silver stands behind a desk and eyes you with his only eye.
Mobs.Description:
He looks exactly as a pirate taken from an old pirate movie. He is wearing a
dark blue coat and has a black pirate-hat on his head.

Mobs.Name: cannibal shaman
Mobs.Description: He has some feathers in his hair, and he looks completely insane.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote chants, "redro taht htiw seirf ekil uoy dluow".

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This boat is made for the high seas although it doesn't look like it by the
by first glance.

Objects.Name: sign important
Objects.Description: A sign is mounted on a pole here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the Continent of Kandoria. Ahead lies realms
that is yet to be explored. Beware Adventurers, because all things are not 
what they seem.
                                 
                              -Nadin the Explorer

Objects.Name: loincloth deerskin
Objects.Description: A deerskin loincloth is lying here.

Objects.Name: amulet
Objects.Description: An amulet made of feathers is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's obvious that this amulet has some kind of magical power.

Objects.Name: axe cannibal
Objects.Description: A primitve axe lies here on the ground.

Objects.Name: odd oddlooking spear
Objects.Description: An odd looking spear lies here.
